instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User cannot connect to VPN after password reset
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Clear cached Kerberos tickets with 'klist purge', re-enter new credentials in VPN client, and re-authenticate. If error 691 persists, have helpdesk re-provision the VPN token.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Unlock account in Active Directory via 'dsmod user <UPN> -disabled no'. Check event logs for the source of failed attempts. Reset password if compromise is suspected and enable MFA.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Laptop does not power on
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Try a hard reset by holding power for 30 seconds with the charger disconnected. Test with a known-good charger. If no POST, escalate to Level 2 for motherboard diagnostics or hardware replacement.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Microsoft Teams crashes immediately on launch
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Clear the Teams cache by deleting %AppData%\Microsoft\Teams\Cache. Repair the installation via Control Panel. If the issue persists, uninstall and reinstall the latest Teams client from the Microsoft portal.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Entire office has no internet access
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check the upstream router and ISP circuit status. Ping default gateway from a local machine. If the gateway is unreachable, restart the edge router. Contact ISP NOC with circuit ID if the router is functional but upstream is down.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Shared network printer shows offline for all users
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Restart the Print Spooler service on the print server. Check the printer's IP address has not changed (compare DHCP lease to configured port). If IP changed, update the printer port in the Windows print server properties.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Emails to external addresses are bouncing with 550 SPF error
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Review the SPF TXT record in public DNS and ensure all sending IPs (including new mail relay IPs) are listed. Add missing IP ranges with 'ip4:' mechanism. Propagation takes up to 48 hours; test with an SPF validator tool.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User received suspicious email asking for their password
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Instruct the user not to click any links or enter credentials. Report the email via the phishing button in Outlook. If credentials were entered, immediately reset the password and revoke active sessions. Notify the security team for investigation.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: New employee cannot log into any company systems
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Verify the account was provisioned correctly in Active Directory. Check group membership and ensure the user has the required baseline security groups. Reset temporary password and confirm UPN matches the user's email.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Remote desktop connection times out
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Confirm VPN is connected first. Check that RDP is enabled on the target machine (System > Remote Desktop). Verify firewall rules allow port 3389 from the VPN subnet. Test connectivity with 'Test-NetConnection -ComputerName <host> -Port 3389'.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' error after returning from leave
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Check if the user's AD account is still active and not expired. Verify the VPN license pool has not been exhausted. Re-enroll the user's MFA token if it has expired and retry authentication. Check certificate validity if using certificate-based VPN.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Split tunneling is routing all traffic through VPN unexpectedly
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Review the VPN client profile configuration to verify split tunneling routes. Update the network access policy in the VPN concentrator to exclude local subnet traffic. Push updated client configuration and have user reconnect.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: VPN connects but user cannot reach internal file shares
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Confirm DNS is resolving internal hostnames by running 'nslookup <share-host>' while connected to VPN. Check that the VPN IP pool range is included in the firewall allow rules for file server access. Flush DNS cache and reconnect.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Always-On VPN drops connection every 30 minutes
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Review IKEv2 keep-alive and dead peer detection settings on the VPN gateway. Extend the idle timeout value in the VPN profile XML. Check for Windows update KB that may have altered network adapter power settings and disable selective suspend.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Cisco AnyConnect fails to install on new Windows 11 machine
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Confirm the AnyConnect version supports Windows 11. Run installer as administrator. Disable antivirus temporarily during install. Check Windows event log for installer errors. If the VP adapter driver fails, manually install the NDIS driver from the AnyConnect package.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User reports VPN is very slow when uploading large files
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Check MTU setting on the VPN adapter; set it to 1400 to reduce fragmentation. Verify no bandwidth throttling policy is applied to the VPN user group. Advise user to use SFTP instead of mapped drives for large transfers.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Two-factor authentication prompt never arrives for VPN login
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Verify the user's phone number and email address in the MFA provider console. Resync the TOTP token or push new enrollment. Check that the RADIUS server can reach the MFA service endpoint. Test with a soft-token app as a fallback.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: macOS user unable to establish VPN connection — certificate error
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Check that the corporate root CA certificate is installed in the macOS System keychain and trusted. Re-import the user certificate via Keychain Access. Verify certificate has not expired and the EKU field includes Client Authentication.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Staff member forgot password and is unable to reach IT desk by phone
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Direct the user to the self-service password reset portal (SSPR). Verify identity via registered backup email or mobile number. If SSPR is unavailable, have a manager submit a verified ticket and an IT admin resets the password with a forced change at next logon.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Service account password expired and is breaking automated jobs
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Reset the service account password in AD, update the credential in Windows Credential Manager or the relevant secrets vault, and restart affected scheduled tasks or services. Enable the 'Password never expires' policy for dedicated service accounts and document rotation schedule.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User account keeps locking out every few minutes
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Use Microsoft's Account Lockout and Management Tools (LockoutStatus.exe) to identify the domain controller generating the lockout. Review Security event ID 4740. Common causes: stale cached credentials on a mapped drive or mobile device. Remove outdated credentials from Credential Manager.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Password reset link in email is expired before the user clicks it
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Check the SSPR token expiry setting — increase it from the default 10 minutes to 30 minutes in Azure AD or the on-prem SSPR config. Ensure email delivery is not delayed by spam filters. Resend the reset link and advise the user to act immediately.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User locked out of admin account after IT policy change
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Use a secondary privileged account to unlock the admin account in ADUC. Investigate whether the new policy's password complexity requirement prompted repeated failed attempts. Communicate policy changes in advance and provide a grace period.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Contractor's temporary account was not disabled after project end
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Disable the account immediately in Active Directory and revoke all associated access tokens and VPN credentials. Review offboarding checklist and automate account expiry via the account expiration date field in AD to prevent recurrence.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User cannot reset password because MFA device was lost
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Verify identity through HR-confirmed employee ID and manager approval ticket. An IT admin performs a manual password reset and re-enrolls MFA using a temporary bypass code. Issue a new MFA token and document the incident per security policy.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Password policy is not enforcing minimum length on a subset of OUs
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Check if a Fine-Grained Password Policy (PSO) is applied to the affected OUs and verify its minPasswordLength attribute. Correct the PSO with 'Set-ADFineGrainedPasswordPolicy -Identity <PSO> -MinPasswordLength 14' and test with a new account.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Desktop hard drive making clicking noise and files are inaccessible
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Immediately back up accessible data. Run S.M.A.R.T. diagnostics ('smartctl -a /dev/sdX'). Do not power cycle repeatedly as it can worsen platters. Raise a hardware replacement ticket. Escalate to data recovery team if backup is incomplete.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Monitor goes black intermittently during work
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Reseat the display cable at both ends. Test with a different cable. Connect monitor to a different port or GPU output. If the issue occurs on another machine, the monitor panel or backlight is failing — replace the monitor. Log asset for disposal.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Keyboard keys are unresponsive after a liquid spill
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Power off immediately and disconnect. Do not turn back on. Place keyboard upside down on absorbent material for 24–48 hours. Attempt to clean with isopropyl alcohol swabs if keycap debris is visible. If keys remain stuck, replace the keyboard — do not risk a laptop motherboard.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Workstation randomly restarts without warning
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Check Windows Event Viewer for critical hardware errors. Run Windows Memory Diagnostic ('mdsched.exe'). Inspect CPU temperature in BIOS/UEFI; thermal throttle or dust build-up can cause emergency shutdowns. Reseat RAM sticks and check PSU voltage rails.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Company laptop screen has permanent horizontal lines across it
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Connect an external monitor. If external display is clean, the issue is with the internal LCD panel or ribbon cable. If lines persist on external display, the GPU is likely failing. Log asset for Level 2 hardware assessment and arrange loaner device.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: USB ports on a docking station have stopped working
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Test with another cable and device on the dock. Update or reinstall dock firmware and USB drivers. Unplug dock for 30 seconds to reset controller. Test on a different laptop to isolate whether the fault is in the dock or the laptop's Thunderbolt controller.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Printer paper feed roller keeps jamming on every print job
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Clean feed rollers with a lightly dampened lint-free cloth. Fan and re-load paper to remove static. Confirm paper weight matches printer spec. If roller worn smooth, order replacement roller kit. Log the printer serial for asset maintenance schedule.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Workstation fans are running at full speed continuously
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Check BIOS temperature readings. Clean dust from heatsink and fans with compressed air. Verify thermal paste is not dry — reapply if the CPU is over 90°C at idle. If fans still max out post-cleaning, the fan controller or temperature sensor may need replacement.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Adobe Acrobat crashes when opening PDFs larger than 50 MB
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Update Acrobat to the latest version. Increase protected mode trust level in Edit > Preferences > Security (Enhanced). If the crash is reproducible, run Acrobat as administrator to bypass ACL-related read errors. Collect crash dump from %TEMP%\AdobeARM.log for escalation.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Office 365 Excel throws 'not enough memory' on large spreadsheets
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Close other applications to free RAM. Split the workbook into multiple files if data exceeds 1M rows. Disable add-ins one by one to isolate conflicts. Upgrade from 32-bit Office to 64-bit via the M365 portal to remove the 2GB heap limit.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Python 3 installation silently fails on Windows corporate image
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Run the installer elevated (Run as Administrator). Confirm that Software Restriction Policy or AppLocker is not blocking the Python MSI. Install to a user-writable directory if admin rights are unavailable. Use the Windows Store Python as a fallback.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Chrome extension causes browser to hang on intranet pages
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Disable extensions one by one in chrome://extensions to identify the culprit. Remove the offending extension. If a business extension is required, file a compatibility report with the intranet development team and use IE/Edge compatibility mode as a temporary workaround.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: AutoCAD 2024 fails to activate on a newly imaged machine
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Confirm the serial number is not already consumed by another machine. Run the Network License Manager to verify license server connectivity. Check that the firewall allows ports 2080 and 27000. If single-user license, sign into the Autodesk account and re-activate.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Windows 10 update stuck at 35% for over three hours
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Wait 30 more minutes to rule out slow disk I/O. If still stuck, force restart and let Windows roll back automatically. Run 'sfc /scannow' and 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth' post-reboot. Re-attempt update from the Windows Update catalog directly.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Zoom video freezes but audio continues during meetings
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Update Zoom to the latest client version. In Zoom Settings > Video, disable HD video and hardware acceleration. Update the webcam driver. If the problem is network-side, check available upload bandwidth ('speedtest-cli') — Zoom HD video requires at least 1.8 Mbps upload.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: ERP application returns 'DLL not found' on startup
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Identify the missing DLL from the error dialog or Application event log. Install the Visual C++ Redistributable package matching the DLL version. If the DLL is a proprietary ERP component, re-run the application installer in repair mode. Contact the ERP vendor if the error persists.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Office subnet lost connectivity after switching a core switch
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check spanning tree topology for a loop — run 'show spanning-tree' on the switch. Verify VLAN tagging on the uplink port matches the previous config. Confirm the management VLAN is correctly trunked. Roll back config from the saved startup-config if loop is not found.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Wireless network drops intermittently in a conference room
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Run a Wi-Fi spectrum scan to check for interference on the channel. Review access point client count — if exceeding 25 active clients, enable band steering or add a second AP. Check AP firmware version and update if behind. Review roaming logs for excessive re-association events.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Network file share is unreachable after a firewall policy update
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Review the recent firewall change log and identify rules added in the last 24 hours. Verify that SMB ports 445 and 137–139 are permitted from the client subnet to the file server. Add a targeted allow rule, avoid opening broad ranges, and test share access.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: IP phones on a specific floor have no dial tone after maintenance
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check that the PoE switch ports for the phones show power delivery. Confirm VLAN 100 (voice VLAN) is configured correctly on affected switch ports. Ping the CUCM/PBX from one phone's maintenance console. Reseat patch cables and check for CDP/LLDP mismatches.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: DNS resolution is intermittent for internal domains
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check DNS server availability with 'nslookup <domain> <dns-server-ip>'. Review DNS server event logs for zone transfer failures. Confirm secondary DNS servers have up-to-date SOA records. Restart DNS service if cache is corrupt and verify forwarder health for external resolution.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Latency spikes on video calls affecting multiple users simultaneously
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Use 'ping' and 'traceroute' to identify where latency is introduced. Check core switch CPU and interface error counters. If a WAN circuit is involved, run a Iperf3 bandwidth test. Contact carrier if the issue is upstream; apply QoS policies to prioritize RTP traffic if the bottleneck is internal.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: New VLAN is not passing traffic between floors
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Verify the new VLAN ID is added to trunk ports on all inter-floor switches. Check layer-3 routing: ensure a SVI is created on the core switch and no ACL is blocking inter-VLAN traffic. Use 'ping' from each SVI to validate routing end-to-end.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: DHCP lease exhausted and new devices cannot get an IP address
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check DHCP server scope statistics. Release stale leases for devices no longer on the network. Expand the scope address range if capacity allows. Set shorter lease times (e.g., 4 hours) for guest VLAN. As a quick fix, reduce the lease time to accelerate recycling.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Color laser printer prints in grayscale despite colour settings
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Check the printer driver settings — confirm colour mode is not set to 'Mono' at the driver or device policy level. Inspect toner cartridge levels for each colour channel. Perform a printer self-test page; if that also shows grayscale, the colour drum unit may require replacement.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Print jobs are stuck in queue and cannot be deleted
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Stop the Print Spooler service ('net stop spooler'), delete all files in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, then restart the spooler ('net start spooler'). Re-send the print job. If jobs still queue, check for a corrupt printer driver and reinstall it.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Printer displays 'low toner' but was replaced last week
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Confirm the correct OEM or approved-compatible cartridge was installed. Reset the page count via the printer admin menu (varies by model). If the message persists, the chip on the cartridge may not have been recognised — reseat the cartridge or update the printer firmware.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Users are printing to wrong printer in an open-plan office
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Audit the default printer setting on affected workstations via Group Policy Preferences. Push a GPO that sets the correct floor printer as default based on the user's OU. Label physical printers clearly and communicate the asset name to staff. Consider deploying Follow-Me printing.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Network printer keeps reverting to offline status after being set online
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Set a static IP on the printer and update the printer port on the print server to match. Add a monitoring ping to detect future IP drift. If DHCP is required, create a reservation using the printer's MAC address. Restart print server after updating port.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Print output has vertical black lines on every page
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Run the printer's internal cleaning cycle. If lines persist, remove the drum unit and gently clean with a dry lint-free cloth. Inspect the drum surface for scratches. A scratched or worn drum unit must be replaced. Document the page count for asset lifecycle tracking.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Duplex printing produces blank second page
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Update the printer firmware and driver to the latest version. Test duplex with a plain single-page document. If the second side is consistently blank, the duplex unit sensor may be faulty — engage warranty or service contract. Workaround: print odd/even pages manually in two passes.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Large PDF takes 20 minutes to print on a network printer
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Enable 'Print as image' in Acrobat's Advanced Print dialog to bypass PostScript rendering. Reduce PDF resolution to 300 DPI before sending. If the print server is the bottleneck, upgrade the server's RAM. Consider deploying a direct-IP printing solution to bypass the print server.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User is not receiving any emails, inbox appears frozen
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Check if the mailbox quota is exceeded in Exchange Admin Center. If over limit, archive or delete old items and re-enable receive. Confirm mail flow rules are not silently deleting inbound messages. Test delivery by sending from an admin account to the affected mailbox.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Outlook calendar invites are not syncing to mobile device
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Remove and re-add the Exchange account from the mobile mail client. Verify the ActiveSync policy allows calendar sync. Check if a Conditional Access policy is blocking the mobile OS version. Run 'Test-ActiveSyncConnectivity' in Exchange PowerShell to validate.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Outbound emails landing in recipient's spam folder
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Check DKIM signature configuration and verify the DKIM TXT record in public DNS matches the selector in Exchange. Ensure PTR record matches the sending mail server's hostname. Submit the IP to MX Toolbox Blacklist Check and delist from any identified RBLs.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Shared mailbox not appearing in Outlook for new team member
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Confirm Full Access permission was granted in Exchange Admin Center. Advise the user to restart Outlook — shared mailboxes with Full Access auto-map if 'Automapping' is enabled. If using Outlook on the web, manually add via File > Open & Export > Other User's Folder.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Email attachments over 10 MB are being silently dropped
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Review the Exchange transport rule for a size-based reject action. Check the per-connector max message size in Exchange Admin Center under Mail Flow > Connectors. If only inbound is affected, check the receive connector max size. Coordinate with the sender to use SharePoint/OneDrive links instead.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Auto-reply out-of-office message is sending to every email, including mailing lists
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: In Exchange, the OOF policy can be scoped to 'Internal only' to prevent mass replies. Adjust with 'Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration -Identity <UPN> -ExternalAudience None'. Educate the user to disable OOF before subscribing to distribution lists.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User cannot send email — NDR says 'relay access denied'
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Check SMTP authentication settings in the client — ensure it is pointing to the correct mail server and using port 587 with STARTTLS. Verify the user account is not relay-restricted by IP in the connector configuration. Test SMTP auth with 'telnet <mailserver> 587' and an AUTH LOGIN command.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Emails sent between two internal users are looping and duplicating
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Review mail flow rules for a redirect or copy action that creates a loop. Check journaling rules. Identify the loop using Message Trace in the Exchange Admin Center. Remove the conflicting rule and test with a single sent message. Monitor message trace for 30 minutes post-fix.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User clicked a link in an email and was asked to enter Microsoft credentials on an unfamiliar site
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Immediately reset the user's Microsoft 365 password and revoke all active sessions via Azure AD > User > Revoke Sessions. Enable MFA if not already active. Submit the phishing URL to Microsoft's phishing report portal. Conduct a sign-in log review for unauthorized access in the last 48 hours.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Email purportedly from the CEO requests an urgent wire transfer to a new supplier
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Flag this as a Business Email Compromise (BEC) attempt. Do not action any financial request via email without a verified phone call to the requester. Block the sending domain on the email gateway. Report to the security team and finance department. File a report with relevant cybercrime authorities if funds were transferred.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User received an invoice attachment that triggered antivirus alert
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Quarantine the email in the mail gateway. Submit the attachment hash to VirusTotal for analysis. Confirm no execution occurred by reviewing process creation events in EDR. If the file executed, isolate the endpoint, engage IR procedures, and preserve memory and disk image for forensics.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Multiple staff report receiving identical SMS messages asking to validate their corporate account
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: This is a smishing campaign. Issue an all-staff alert via a trusted channel (Teams or intranet). Block the originating SMS shortcode if identifiable. Instruct all recipients not to click links or call back numbers. Collect samples from staff and report to the mobile carrier and security team.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Security scanner flagged an open RDP port exposed to the internet on a server
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Immediately restrict RDP port 3389 to VPN subnet only via firewall ACL. Enable NLA (Network Level Authentication). Review RDP event logs for unauthorized access attempts (Event ID 4625). Enable account lockout after 5 failed attempts. Consider deploying a jump server or Bastion host for all remote admin access.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: VPN client is showing 'certificate revoked' on a device that just had its OS reinstalled
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Re-enroll the device certificate via the SCEP/MDM profile. Confirm the machine certificate CN matches the device FQDN expected by the VPN gateway. Clear the local certificate store of any stale certs. Re-import the root CA trust chain before re-issuing the device cert.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Password must be changed but the new password is rejected as not meeting complexity requirements
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Remind the user of the complexity policy: minimum 14 characters, upper/lowercase, digit, and special character, and must not contain username or display name. If policy was recently changed, verify RSOP (Resultant Set of Policy) on the client. Check for a PSO overriding the domain default policy.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Company laptop dropped and now has a cracked screen
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Log a physical damage ticket. If under warranty or accidental damage cover, initiate a manufacturer RMA. Provide the user with a loaner device immediately. Back up data via MDM remote wipe policy before sending for repair. Record the incident in the asset management system.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Antivirus software is preventing installation of a business-approved application
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Identify the AV detection name from the quarantine log. Submit a false-positive report to the AV vendor. Add a temporary exclusion for the application installer path under admin approval, install the application, then remove the exclusion. Document the exception in the change log.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Network throughput on a server NIC drops to near zero under load
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check NIC driver version and update if outdated. Disable interrupt moderation or adjust RSS (Receive Side Scaling) queues. Review interface error counters for CRC errors indicating a physical layer fault. Test with a different cable and switch port. If teaming is configured, check LACP negotiation status.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Print server is consuming 100% CPU whenever a large print job is submitted
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Identify the spool file size in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS. Upgrade print server RAM and CPU if consistently under load. Enable 'Print directly to printer' to bypass spooling for large-format printers. Stagger large jobs using a print queue scheduling policy.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User receiving hundreds of spam emails per hour after their email address was exposed
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Enable anti-spam policies in the email gateway with stricter scoring. Apply a temporary rule to quarantine mail from unknown senders. Submit the user's address for removal from known spam lists. Consider creating an email alias and migrating the user so the exposed address can be decommissioned.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: A network device is sending unusual outbound traffic on port 4444 at 2 AM
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Isolate the device immediately from the network using a firewall block or switch port shutdown. Port 4444 is commonly used by Metasploit reverse shells. Capture a network packet trace and preserve disk image. Engage the incident response team and check for lateral movement in SIEM logs. Revoke all credentials used on that device.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User's laptop Wi-Fi disconnects when moving between floors
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Enable 802.11r (Fast BSS Transition) on the WLAN controller for seamless roaming. Adjust AP transmit power to reduce overlap dead zones. Check the RSSI threshold for client roaming in the wireless profile. Update the wireless NIC driver on the laptop.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Outlook keeps prompting for password despite correct credentials
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Remove the saved credentials from Windows Credential Manager. Disable Modern Authentication temporarily to test if legacy auth is the issue. Re-add the Exchange account in Outlook using the correct autodiscover URL. If using OAuth, re-sign in through the Microsoft account sign-in dialog.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Workstation NIC shows 'Limited connectivity' after moving desks
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Confirm the patch cable is fully seated at both ends. Test with a cable tester — look for miswired pairs. Check the switch port for the correct VLAN assignment after relocation. Run 'ipconfig /release && ipconfig /renew' to obtain a new DHCP lease.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Scanner attached to a printer stops working after a Windows update
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Roll back the Windows Update if identified as the cause via Device Manager driver history. Reinstall the scanner WIA/TWAIN driver from the manufacturer's website. Check that the Windows Image Acquisition (WIA) service is running. If WIA is running, delete and re-add the scanner in Control Panel.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Staff member's mailbox was accessed from a foreign country at 3 AM
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Immediately reset the user's password and revoke sessions in Azure AD. Review the sign-in logs for the access IP, device, and actions taken. Check whether sensitive emails or attachments were forwarded. Engage the security team for a full mailbox audit. Enable risky sign-in alerts via Azure AD Identity Protection going forward.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User Outlook keeps switching back to an old email signature after each update
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Check if a Group Policy or Exclaimer/signature management solution is overwriting the user local signature on login. Review the GPO under User Configuration > Policies > Windows Settings > Scripts for any signature deployment script. If a central signature tool is in use, update the user template in the management console rather than locally in Outlook.
